It finds hardcoded text in React, Next.js, Vue and React Native apps, generates translation keys, translates them, and rewrites the code to use i18n, then delivers it all as a pull request. Incremental runs only translate what changed. It's available as a web dashboard, a CLI (npx @babelize/cli), an SDK, build plugins, and an MCP server for AI coding agents.
babelize.target_customers_original: Developers and small product teams shipping web/mobile apps who want to go multi
babelize.pricing_original: Free tier + paid credit-based plans (dashboard), free CLI via npx @babelize/cli.
babelize.value_proposition_original: Auto-localizes React, Next.js, Vue and React Native apps — extracts hardcoded strings, generates keys, translates, and injects i18n code, then opens a PR.
babelize.problem_solved_original: Adding i18n to an existing app means weeks of manually pulling strings out of components, wiring up libraries and managing translation files. Babelize does it in one run, and incremental runs only translate what changed.

sources.content_provenance: Revenue: TrustMRR reports provider-API verification; product details: founder/user supplied, not independently verified.
